description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, and updating timesheets, along with input validation, authorization checks, and transaction management.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing employee timesheets including listing, creating, and updating timesheet records. It integrates with underlying services and handles validation, authorization, and transaction management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list an employee's timesheets, with date filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: validateDateInputs
methods.description: Validates that the fromDate and toDate parameters are correctly provided and logically ordered.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number from request parameters.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'fromDate' query parameter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'toDate' query parameter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getTimeSheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheets based on filter parameters and returns collection result including total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet record for an employee on a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing timesheet with an action (e.g., approve, reject) and optional comment, handling transactions and validations.

methods.name: setTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Logs actions performed on a timesheet, including state changes and comments.
